proposals.before: Huguan's steadfast lord—autumn-thousand years awakened self.
proposals.after: The elder of Huguan remonstrated with his ruler; Qianqiu brought him to recognize his error.
proposals.reason: 千秋 is Qianqiu, a personal name, not autumn-thousand years. Huguan denotes the remonstrating elder, not a steadfast lord. The two parallel clauses invoke people whose interventions awakened the Han ruler; the idiomatic merely labels an allusion. Primary cross-reference: Hanshu 63, Huguan elder Mao’s memorial and Qianqiu’s defense of the wronged prince. Author independently checked the full Chinese context; this remains an unapproved proposal.
